title: Smackdown!
summary: The setup was a bit different from yesterday’s, but the early action is eerily similar. Whereas we opened yesterday with a solid rally based upon IPO enthusiasm, today we saw futures erode steadily throughout the pre-market. Then, seemingly out of the blue, a bounce morphed into a nascent rally shortly after the bell rang at 9:30 ET. Unfortunately for those buyers, the S&P 500’s (SPX) brief foray into positive territory was quashed quickly and firmly. Shortly before midday, stocks are in the throes of another tech-led selloff.
